scenes.name: ribbons-open
scenes.prompt: The golden road curls into an enormous open spiral suspended in luminous pearl cloud. Sweeping curved ribbons of intricately engraved brass rotate around a large dark oval opening just left of center. The old black towers are receding at the edges. We follow the road into the opening, nested terraces and perforated golden ribs unfolding around the passage like the petals of a mechanical flower. Clear spacious central opening, strong flowing sculptural curves, microscopic carved detail, an impossible ancient city changing into a higher-dimensional sculpture. Black lacquer, luminous gold, ivory cloud. No people, no text, no frame.

scenes.name: opal-inside-the-gold
scenes.prompt: Inside the immense curled architectural flower, golden ribbon roads are becoming translucent ivory and opalescent crystal. A deep oval passage remains visible between sweeping nested ribs. The ribs unfold into impossibly intricate mineral latticework, layers of tiny carved chambers and fractal filigree, rose glass and cyan light beginning to glow between the ivory surfaces. Ancient brass engravings dissolve into crystalline veins. Extraordinary surreal dimensional sculpture, clear spatial depth through the opening, fine detailed mineral material, floating in luminous pearl atmosphere. No people, no text, no borders.

motion_note.intent: The actual road has oval perforations and nested loops. Follow those loops into a regional unfurling; carry drift and forward velocity while the central ribbons curl. Let material gradually turn from brass to opal.
